home.subtitle: You negotiate with us in Germany — under German law. We manage the entire production and delivery through our own infrastructure in Turkey.

home.pillar1Desc: High-precision turning and milling, assembly and prototyping. Our partner factories produce to strict German tolerance standards — under our direct supervision.
home.pillar2Desc: Custom contract furniture, hotel fit-outs and hospitality interiors from our own furniture production line. Premium materials, lasting design.
home.pillar3Desc: Eco-friendly cardboard, plastic packaging and specialty solutions — directly from our logistics infrastructure. Optimized for safe transport and excellent presentation.

leistungen.subtitle: Our own production facilities in Turkey, your contract under German law. No middlemen, no detours.
leistungen.cat1Desc: High-precision manufacturing for demanding industries. Turned parts, milled parts, and ISO-compliant assemblies. Tolerances up to ±0.005 mm and certifications for defense and automotive manufacturing.
leistungen.cat2Desc: Exclusive furnishings for restaurants, hotels, and cafes. Durable materials (FSC timber, heavy-duty textiles) and custom interior concepts directly from the factory.
leistungen.cat3Desc: B2B packaging materials and commercial hospitality solutions. Eco-friendly cardboard, Food-Safe certifications, and tailored Horeca equipment.
leistungen.pricingSubtitle: Our conditions for full-service Supply Chain Management (Sourcing, QC, Customs).
leistungen.catalogSubtitle: Request our current 2025 catalogs. All products come directly from our own production.
leistungen.faqSubtitle: Transparency and reliability for your import process.
leistungen.faq1Q: Are there customs duties when importing from Turkey?
leistungen.faq1A: No. Due to our membership in the European Customs Union (since 1996), most trade goods between Turkey and the EU are exempt from customs duties. We handle the correct declaration.
leistungen.faq2Q: Who is my contract partner and who is liable?
leistungen.faq2A: Your contract partner is exclusively our German company under German law. We guarantee quality, logistics checks, and final delivery. You bear no foreign risk.
leistungen.faq3Q: How do you check quality and specifications?
leistungen.faq3A: Thanks to our own physical presence in Turkey (Antalya Headquarter) and 120+ qualified production lines, we conduct strict on-site Quality Control (QC) directly at the factory.
leistungen.ctaSubtitle: Benefit from our own production capacity — direct and without detours.

uberUns.subtitle: Software Engineer & B2B Manufacturing Partner
uberUns.intro: I am Osman Kadir, Tech-Founder and your direct access to Turkey's manufacturing power. My mission is to combine deep software engineering and AI expertise with a massive physical manufacturing network in Turkey.
uberUns.bullet1: I build digital systems that optimize physical supply chains. From AI-driven analysis to door-to-door delivery.
uberUns.bullet2: CNC manufacturing, furniture production and industrial packaging under German quality supervision. Everything from a single source, contractually under German law.
uberUns.outro: Our goal is to give you the maximum competitive advantage — through our own production capacity and software-optimized supply chains.
